Кальций.about: Macromineral: bone mineralization, vascular tone; Without deficiency it is useless, it works in pregnancy.
Кальций.caution: Effect in pregnancy: High doses ≥1 g/day reduce preeclampsia, especially when dietary Ca is LOW. The risk of HELLP syndrome is increased (RR 2.67, but absolutely rare). Outside of pregnancy: prevention of fractures with vitamin D only.
effects: Fractures: MA inconsistent; without deficit it is useless
Кальций.food_sources: Dairy products, sesame seeds, greens, fish with bones; absorption depends on vitamin D.
Кальций.guidelines: Cochrane 2018: ≥1 g/d in pregnancy reduces preeclampsia. For bone - 500–600 mg + D; Without deficit there is no benefit.
Кальций.how_to_choose: First food (milk/sesame); supplement 500–600 mg + vitamin D. Carbonate or citrate - as tolerated.

interactions.note: reduces absorption, separate doses for 2-4 hours

mechs: Fractures: MA inconsistent; without deficit it is useless
Calcium in pregnancy: regulation of vascular tone
BP is up less often (RR 0.65), preeclampsia is lower (≥1 g/d; 15,730)
The effect of calcium on blood pressure in normotensive patients (primary prevention)
Small shifts in blood pressure; preventive benefit not established (Cochrane 2022)
Кальций.myths: “The more, the better” - without a deficiency, it does not prevent fractures. “Reduces blood pressure for everyone” - the effect is small in normotensive patients (Cochrane 2022).
Кальций.name: Calcium
Кальций.onset: Preeclampsia: courses during pregnancy; on bone - months or years, and only with vitamin D.
Кальций.title: Calcium
Кальций.who_needs: Pregnant women with low dietary Ca (≥1 g/d reduces preeclampsia); elderly with deficiency - be sure to take vitamin D.
